original.description: Survivors of the Japanese carrier Hiryu under guard on Midway, June 1942, after being brought ashore from USS Ballard (AVD-10); a Marine sentry with a rifle stands behind the seated prisoners. Official U.S. Navy photograph 80-G-79984-28 (second image under that number in the Online Library record).
original.photographer: U.S. Navy (photographer not named in the Online Library record)
original.archive: Official U.S. Navy photograph 80-G-79984-28, now in the collections of the National Archives; Naval Historical Center Online Library, read via the ibiblio.org HyperWar mirror
original.original_dimensions: 740 × 495 (Online Library scan; the printed caption strip along the top edge is cropped here, and nothing else is altered)
original.licence: public domain — official U.S. Navy photograph, a work of the United States federal government (80-G series, National Archives)

colorization.status: not colorized, and this one should stay so: these are prisoners of war under guard, and the project publishes the record itself rather than a treatment of it

content_policy: ok — living prisoners of war under guard, unwounded; no gore. Published as the Navy's own record of the rescue, with the men's circumstances stated plainly in the caption
caption: Survivors of Hiryū under guard on Midway, June 1942, brought ashore from USS Ballard the day after their rescue and later shipped to Hawaii. Official U.S. Navy photograph 80-G-79984-28.
credit: Official U.S. Navy photograph 80-G-79984-28, now in the collections of the National Archives; via the Naval Historical Center Online Library (ibiblio.org mirror). Public domain.
notes: Fetched 2026-08-30 from the Online Library page catalogued in source:nhc-midway-rescue. The scan carries the Library's printed caption strip along the top edge; the strip is cropped and nothing else is altered. The one-picture-per-beat rule (ADR 0012) gives the closing beat to 80-G-79974-1; this image is registered against the epilogue battle as the second photograph of the series, and is a candidate hero for the Midway pack (sand-lry.6), where a higher-resolution National Archives master should replace this 740px Library scan.
